<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Test: move to rightmost position and try UP/DOWN there
# Current cursor position: col 15 (leftmost)
# Move to rightmost
result = action(['LEFT'])
print(f"After LEFT - step: {current_frame.step}")

white_now = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
for n in white_now:
    b = n['boundary']
    print(f"Cursor: ({min(p[0] for p in b)},{min(p[1] for p in b)})")

# Record current hashes
current_B = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10]
current_hashes = {}
for n in current_B:
    b = n['boundary']
    r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    current_hashes[(r,c)] = n['hash']

# Try UP at rightmost position
result = action(['UP'])
print(f"\nAfter UP at rightmost - step: {current_frame.step}")

after_B = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] >= 10]
after_hashes = {}
for n in after_B:
    b = n['boundary']
    r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    after_hashes[(r,c)] = n['hash']

changed = []
for k in current_hashes:
    if k in after_hashes and current_hashes[k] != after_hashes[k]:
        changed.append((k, current_hashes[k], after_hashes[k]))
print(f"Changed symbols: {changed}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
